problem: The CMS page crashed during page assurance because the single-element selector helper was overwritten by a querySelectorAll helper.
rootCause: Two variables named $ were declared consecutively; on() therefore received an array and called addEventListener on it.
root_cause: Two variables named $ were declared consecutively; on() therefore received an array and called addEventListener on it.
preventionRule: CMS DOM helpers must keep distinct single-element and collection selectors; event binding may only call addEventListener on a single Element.
prevention: Keep querySelector and querySelectorAll helpers separately named.
Regression-test the helper declarations and event binder.
Keep /cms in full public-page browser assurance.

evaluation.expected: CMS binds events to a single DOM element while collection iteration uses a distinct helper.
